name: karpathy-guidelines
tagline_zh: 写代码总被AI带偏？让它先过这道闸：小步改动、早说假设、可验证才算完。专治过度设计，改完不炸。
tagline_en: AI coding gone wild? This skill enforces surgical changes, early assumptions, and verifiable done—so refactors.
desc_en: Behavioral guardrails for LLM-assisted coding. Use when writing, reviewing, or refactoring code in any project to avoid overcomplication, keep changes surgical, surface assumptions early, and execute against verifiable success criteria.
why_zh: 同类靠规则清单，它靠行为约束——强制你每次提交前过三关，从源头掐死过度设计。
why_en: Unlike plain rule lists, it enforces a pre-commit ritual: three checks that kill over-engineering at the root.
